*NOTE: For the 147NCFS, N40NCFS samples, the cycle 4 147 & N40 samples were added as fillers so that there is enough DNA for sequencing.*

*Ligand plates (lig147, ligN40)*

*TF Dilution Buffer*

500 mL

| 1 M Tris-HCl pH 8 | 5 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| BSA | 0.5 g |
| KCl | 5.59 g |
| Ethylene Glycol | 250 mL |
| 100 mM ZnSO4.H2O | 50 uL |

*Blocking Buffer Salt-free*

*Blocking buff (salt free): 25mM Tris, 0.5% BSA, 0.1% tween, 0.02% NaN3 pH8 \[500 mL buffer\]*

25 mM Tris pH 8 \= 12.5 mL  
0.5 % BSA \= 2.5 g BSA  
0.1 % Tween20 \= 500 uL  
0.02% NaN3 \= 0.1 g

*Elution Buffer*

0.1% Tween, 10 mM Tris pH7.8, 1 mM MgCl2 (0.5mM in PCR rxn)  
   
500 mL buffer:  
\-    	500 uL Tween20  
\-    	5 mL Tris pH 8  
\-    	500 uL 1M MgCl2

*ELF ligand EcoRV gel run*

20 ng of DNA has been loaded per well and run at 200 V, 180 mins (on ice) on a 20% TBE gel.
